ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error codes for clients to branch on instead of
guessing from the HTTP status.  The string value is the wire format.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
Unified error envelope — mirrors ApiResponse so clients see one consistent
shape across success and failure (`success` discriminates).

ParadigmInfo.title: ParadigmInfo
ParadigmInfo.description:
Metadata for a discovered stimulation paradigm.

Fields
------
id           Machine identifier; unique per plugin (= manifest package.id).
plugin_type  Registry key used to actually start the paradigm.
display_name Human-readable label shown in the UI.
description  Optional long description.
version      Semver string from the manifest, if present.
source       "builtin" (ships with app) or "user" (downloaded / self-written).

Deprecated
----------
name         Alias for ``display_name``; kept for one release cycle.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: 'default' writes settings.toml; any other value names a profile (created on first write)

engine_restart_required.title: Engine Restart Required
engine_restart_required.description: True → stop/start the engine for changes to take effect

off_whitelist_keys.title: Off Whitelist Keys
off_whitelist_keys.description: Keys present in the file but outside the API whitelist (hand-edited; read-only here)

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The session created/ended for this recording

paradigm.title: Paradigm
paradigm.description: Paradigm name for the session; defaults to config value

StartTrialRequest.title: StartTrialRequest
StartTrialRequest.description:
Trigger one or more stimulation trials.

n_trials     — how many trials to run (paradigm-agnostic base parameter).
trial_params — per-trial target/event ids; len must equal n_trials when
               provided.  None → each trial uses the paradigm default.

StimulationStatusResponse.title: StimulationStatusResponse
StimulationStatusResponse.description:
Live status of the Stimulation subsystem.

active          — the application service has issued a StartStimulation command.
process_alive   — the Stimulation subprocess is currently running (auto_spawn only).
engine_connected — the Stimulation process has an active IPC connection to the engine.
